Variants.Content: Weir City is the seat of the Weir family in the Dorne Mountains, close to the border of the Bone Road and the Stormlands. The "road" here is not equivalent to a flat avenue, but a passage through the Red Mountains that can be ambushed and interrupted by heavy rain or falling rocks. The Weir family was closely connected to the history of the frontier disputes, and local society therefore valued the memory of riding, scouting, water storage and revenge more than Sunspear's court. The bone road allows caravans and messengers to travel through, and it also allows war to suddenly cross the mountains. The geographical significance of the city of Vail lies in guarding this narrow and stubborn passage.

Entry Wyl Castle A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Wyl Castle They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
